verdict.rationale: AWS ships Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as a first-party platform for building and deploying agents. Its product pages document framework-agnostic deployment to production, tracing of agent steps, and managed authentication and access control for tool calls. The evidence comes from product and marketing pages rather than in-depth runtime or orchestration documentation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party runtime/orchestration docs (scaling, session and state management, multi-agent orchestration), independent or hands-on corroboration that AgentCore works in production as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents have a managed home — first-party agent runtimes/orchestration services shipped and documented, not just a blog vision

citations.quote: Accelerate agents to production with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, the end-to-end platform to build, connect and optimize highly capable agents securely, at scale
The same code that runs on your laptop can deploy to production with security built into the platform.
When something goes wrong, you can see what steps your agent took, what it called, and where it went off track.
AgentCore helps you handle the authentication and access control so you focus on what your agent does, rather than how it gets permission to do it.
